title: Choosing what to open and what to sell
target: How to decide in TCG Card Shop Simulator which packs to open yourself and which to leave sealed on the shelf.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Stock you can either sell or open
A sense of what your customers want

steps.do: Check which pack tier you are dealing with before opening anything.
steps.because: packs are named per tier rather than being one product (ECollectionPackType)

steps.do: Leave sealed stock on the shelf when it is selling as it is.
steps.because: the game ships pack artwork for each tier, so sealed stock is a product in its own right (T_CardPackRare)

steps.do: Watch the reveal rather than skipping past it, since the game shows what you got.
steps.because: opening runs as a sequence with its own interface (CardOpeningSequence)

steps.do: Price a card at the moment you see it when it is worth something.
steps.because: there is a price popup at the reveal (CardPricePopupUI)

steps.do: Put what you open where it can be displayed rather than leaving it in a pile.
steps.because: cards are display objects with settings of their own (CardUISetting)

commonMistakes: Opening stock that was already selling sealed.
Assuming a higher tier guarantees a better card.
Leaving opened cards lying in a pile.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
